title: Topic 1: Home and Abroad
welcome_lead: Today's adventure: Topic 1: Home and Abroad in GCSE French.
meta_desc: GCSE French adventure on Topic 1: Home and Abroad.
final_note: You worked through the key terms in Topic 1: Home and Abroad.

concepts.def: Describing your home: the type of dwelling, its rooms and what you do there.
Your local area and neighbourhood, including nearby amenities and what it is like to live there.
Holidays at home and abroad: destinations, activities and how you travel.
Means of transport for getting around at home and travelling abroad, e.g. 'en train', 'en avion'.
Accommodation when away, such as 'l'hôtel', 'le camping' and 'l'auberge de jeunesse'.
Going abroad: comparing life and places in other countries with your own home region.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Topic 1: Home and Abroad — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Topic 1: Home and Abroad brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Topic 1: Home and Abroad.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I live in a house in the countryside'?
options: J'habite dans une maison à la campagne.
Je habite une maison campagne.
J'habite un maison à la campagne.
J'ai dans une maison campagne.
en avion
en train
à pied
en voiture
